messages:
Liam: Heads up - canary start tomorrow 06:00 UTC for the new price sheet. Small ask: we need a rapid feedback loop for grandfathering exceptions.
Nora: who's owning the exception queue? want to avoid delays during the 24h canary.
Felix: I'll run the exception detector. plan: auto-flag orgs where legacy_credit > 0 OR legacy_contract_clause=true. push to FIN-1602.
billing-bot: Ticket FIN-1602 created: "canary-grandfathering-exceptions-queue" assigned: Felix, Rae. https://tickets.redwood/FIN-1602
Rae (CS): CS asks for a short template to notify affected customers if we need to apply manual adjustments. can legal sign-off the language?
Legal-Support: Draft template OK for canary; final language required for any live billing. Provide sample variables and an opt-out link.
Liam: automation request: when an exception is flagged, create a draft ticket and ping #support-escalations with org_id + reason; also tag Finance for manual review within 2 hours.
Felix: proto SQL for detector sent to FIN-1602: ```SELECT org_id, legacy_credit_balance, legacy_contract_clause FROM finance.customers WHERE region!='test' AND active=true;```
Nora: small safety measure: for canary wave, we'll neutralize credits in sim only. no live charge changes. If any manual adjustment needed, we escalate to manual flow and pause.
Rae (CS): also want to simulate customer-facing email for B cohort only, to validate unsubscribe/opt-out flows. please mark those emails as [SIMULATED] so we don't confuse CS.
Liam: monitoring rule: if more than 4 exceptions per 100 orgs in the canary, stop and triage. send summary to execs and schedule hotfix.
Felix: initial scan of canary sample (50 orgs): 3 exceptions found (org_221, org_442, org_889). org_889 has both credit and a legacy clause. adding to FIN-1602 exclude list.
Legal-Support: org_889 flagged for manual legal review before any messaging.
billing-bot: FIN-1602 updated: exclude_list.csv uploaded; draft-notice.md attached.
Nora: can we get a one-hour rolling digest to #finance during the canary instead of per-flag pings? want to reduce noise but still be quick.
Liam: ok, send immediate alerts for enterprise-tier orgs, hourly digest for others.
Felix: implement alert rules and will run the canary dry-run in staging now. report back in 30m.
Rae (CS): will prep CS playbook for handling inbound queries (script + escalation path). cc @Nora
Liam: thanks all. quick preflight at 05:15 UTC tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
